text.en:
Section 2(2), (3), (4), (6) and (7) of Executive Order No. 423,
Series of 1990, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SEC. 2. The prime commodities and their respective price
ceilings are hereby set as follows:

COOKING OIL
(Single Refined, contents only)
19.60
10.40

20 445

The price ceilings of other commodities provided in Executive
Order No. 423 and 440, Series of 1990, as well as the price ceilings provided
above shall remain in full force and effect until revoked.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in a national newspaper of general circulation and shall remain
in effect until revoked.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 10th day of January, in the year of Our
Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety-one.
